thread:
ali: Quick sync — proposing a small webinar + post series to drive PLG activation next week. Goal: 3k signups, 15% click-to-start, +10% activation vs baseline. Idea: 30-min demo + 2 short follow-up posts with starter prompt templates and a free 1,000-token credit for attendees. :rocket:

marisol: love this. timeline? we need creative + landing by Thu so growth can push.

ali: timeline: creative draft by Tue, landing + tracking by Thu, webinar Wed next week. can growth do paid and organic mix?

jake: paid budget ok. quick Q — do we gate credits to attending only or to registrants? tradeoff: higher signups vs conversion from attendees.

sophie: suggest split: registrant credit (200 tokens) + attendee bonus (800 tokens) so we reward attendance but keep signup friction low.

tariq: agree with split. also want a tiny prompt pack in the confirmation email: 3 starter prompts (summarize, code refactor, product copy). keeps users engaged immediately.

marisol: copy tack: subject line variants A/B: "Build with Redwood Inference — free starter credits" vs "Ship LLM features faster — get 1,000 tokens". we should test which works.

ali: put both in the send. growth to allocate 50/50 for registry CTA. jake please add UTM and tracking snippet.

jake: adding note — use utm_campaign=credit_webinar_0326, utm_medium=slack_post or paid depending on channel. snippet for landing devs: `?utm_source={{channel}}&utm_medium={{medium}}&utm_campaign=credit_webinar_0326&variant={{variant}}`

ops-bot: Deploy preview available: https://redwood-infer-preview.app/credit-webinar-0326 (preview expires in 48h)

sophie: email flow outline: confirmation -> 2-day reminder with top prompts -> 1hr before reminder + calendar link -> post-webinar thank you + claim credit + prompt pack link. Also include quickstart link to console + embed sample code.

tariq: for onboarding funnel, add an "Activation Nudge" route: if user has clicked claim credit but not called the API within 48h, send an in-app message with a one-click starter prompt run. Could be: "Try this prompt with your free credits" button.

marisol: metrics we track: registrant->attendee rate, attendee->claim-credit rate, claim->first-call within 24h, avg tokens used first session. dashboard owner: marisol/growth.

ali: rollout plan: canary 20% audience for subject variant B, rest A. Also test landing hero copy: "1,000 tokens for attendees" vs "Starter prompts + credits". small hermes experiment so we can measure quality impact by cohort.

jake: ETA for landing instrumentation: Thu morning. will include cohort param `cohort=webinar_0326_variantA|B|canary`. will send PR.

marisol: creative ask to design: 3 social posts (launch, 24h reminder, post-webinar highlight) + 1 webinar banner + email templates. tone: practical, developer-first, low-friction.

ali: who can own webinar logistics (zoom + recording)?

sophie: I'll own logistics. will book Zoom, record, and auto-upload to content bucket. tagging: webinar/credit-0326.

tariq: quick reminder on privacy/compliance for Private customers — credits should not grant access to customer models. needs a callout on the landing and email about data usage and retention.

ali: good catch. add a short line: "Credits can be used on our hosted API only; your data usage follows Redwood's standard retention policy. For private deployments contact your AE."

marisol: creative draft deadline Tue EOD. Sophie, can you confirm Zoom + calendar event by Tue?

sophie: confirmed. I'll share calendar invite with join links and speaker bios by Tue noon.

jake: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/marketing/credit-webinar-0326 (WIP) — will push instrumentation and UTM changes by Wed AM.

ali: action items recap: marisol = copy + A/B lines; jake = landing + tracking PR; sophie = logistics + recordings; tariq = prompt pack + activation nudge flows; ali = ads plan and audience list. We'll sync Fri for final go/no-go. :eyes:

marisol: also request: can analytics add a funnel checkpoint for "claimed credit" so we can attribute ad source correctly?

ops-bot: Analytics event added by analytics-bot: `credit_claimed` tracked with properties {"utm_campaign","cohort","variant","user_id"} (preview).

tariq: small UX ask — on claim flow, make the claim button modal show the sample prompt runner and a single-click "Run with credits" CTA. reduces drop-off.

ali: love it. prioritize that as must-have for launch.

sophie: one last note — speaker will demo embedding search + prompt templates. keep demo <15m so we have 10m q&a.

ali: perfect. thanks everyone, I'll schedule the Fri go/no-go. :sparkles:
